lines: •Raising our FY 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $3.10 to $3.14, up ~15% year-over-year at the midpoint
“We are raising our full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $3.10 to $3.14, reflecting our strong year-to-date performance and our confidence in the trajectory of the business.
For FY 2026, Fortive now expects adjusted diluted earnings per share of $3.10 to $3.14.
